note_mcp_surface: rustre-mcp.exe does not expose any STABS-specific tool. STABS parsing is reachable only indirectly when an ELF binary containing .stab/.stabstr sections is opened via project_open and the symbol pipeline runs. As with rustre-symbols-pdb, the comparison is between the validator's pure-Python reimplementation and the crate's documented Rust behaviour (see reports/rustre-symbols-stabs.md). No regressions versus the report; self-tests pass.
